note: Historical multiples computed from Sky's OWN disclosed market capitalisation at each 30 June balance date (found in the goodwill-impairment note of each annual report). Yahoo's 10y monthly price series is NOT usable here: it retroactively adjusts pre-Sept-2021 prices for the 1-for-10 share consolidation while core_metrics carries as-reported historical share counts, so price x shares double-counts and implies an $8.5bn FY2017 market cap against the $1.34bn Sky actually reported.
basis: market cap disclosed by Sky; equity/NI/EBITDA/FCF from core_metrics (statutory)

guardrails.comment: Sky has NEVER traded above ~1.0x book in 10 years. An intrinsic value implying P/B materially above 1.0x, or EV/EBITDA above ~5.6x, is outside anything this market has ever paid for this asset.
